diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a repeating cycle every 3 minutes that emits an action, delays, and emits another action. The candidate implemented this as a one-shot sequence (period=0) with a trailing delay. F2 shows the IR expected an action at 190000ms (10s + 180s), but the candidate had already terminated. The candidate failed to loop and re-arm the body every 3 minutes.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period from 0 to 180000 (3 MIN) to make the script repeating. Restructured the script into a loop that executes the body, then waits for the cycle period before the next iteration, removing the trailing delay which belongs to the next cycle's start.
